text: Human preference benchmarks in one screen A preference benchmark asks which of two answers a person (or a model standing in for one) likes better, and turns many such choices into a rating.
label: core

section: human preference benchmarks in one screen

section: from votes to a rating
text: On Arena's scale: P(A beats B) = 1 / (1 + 10 (R B − R A ) / 400 ) R a model's Arena score; only differences mean anything, so the scale is pinned by an anchor (FastChat set Mixtral-8x7B-Instruct to 1114; rating_systems.py ) 400, 10 the chess Elo convention: a 100-point gap is a 64.0% expected win rate, 200 points 76.0% derived The ratings are the maximum-likelihood fit to all votes at once: a logistic regression with one column per model (+1 for the left model, −1 for the right) and the vote as the label.
label: core

section: from votes to a rating
text: A tie counts as half a win for each side ("this form naturally counts a draw as half a win and half a loss", in the same file).

section: style control: separating what is said from how
text: Style control answers that inside the same regression: add columns for the difference in style between the two answers, so the style effect gets its own coefficient and each model's rating is what is left ( Arena, 29 Aug 2024 ). logit P(A wins) = ln10 · (R A − R B ) + γ · z z four style features, each the difference over the sum, (x A − x B ) / (x A + x B + 1), standardised over all votes: answer tokens, markdown headers, list items, bold spans (FastChat's STYLE_CONTROL_ELEMENTS_V1); the ratio makes 500 against 520 tokens nearly equal and 20 against 40 very different γ the style coefficients, fitted with the ratings; a small ridge penalty (0.5) as in FastChat Reproduced.
label: core

section: style control: separating what is said from how
text: On the 1.76 million votes of the August 2024 public log this page's fit gives γ = 0.249 for length, 0.024 for headers, 0.031 for lists and 0.019 for bold, the values LMArena published (0.249, 0.024, 0.031, 0.019), and 0.268 for length alone (published 0.267) reproduced .
label: core
